description: Had a great time at Senator Rob Rolison’s Orange County Volunteer Appreciation Party! It was wonderful to meet so many voters, thank the volunteers who make campaigns possible, and spend time with Senator Rolison and his dream team. The energy and enthusiasm in Orange County was incredible! We had lots of laughs, if you couldn’t tell!!! I’m so grateful for everyone who continues to get involved and make a difference in our communities 🇺🇸
